name: formbuilder-basic
description: FormBuilder (hs-uix) — the declarative form primitive. Prefer this over hand-rolling an Input stack when the form has more than ~2 fields or needs validation. `columns` sets the grid; `colSpan: 2` or `width: 'full'` makes a field span both columns. Field `type` is one of: text, textarea, number, currency, date, time, datetime, select, multiselect, toggle, checkbox, checkboxGroup, radioGroup. `submitAlign` (hs-uix 1.6.4+) places the Submit/Cancel row: 'start' | 'end' | 'between'. Use 'end' to right-align a lone Submit in a modal — no Flex wrapper needed. Submit position defaults to 'bottom'; set 'none' and drive via ref when embedding in a modal footer.
